results.content: 81 v AWS Prescriptive Guidance AWS Key Management Service best practices AWS Key Management Service best practices Amazon Web Services (contributors) March 2025 (document history) AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) is a managed service that makes it easy for you to create and control the cryptographic keys that are used to protect your data. It considers current recommendations that use the following dimensions: • Managing keys – Delegation options for management and key storage choices • Data protection – Encrypting data within your own applications vs in AWS services doing it on your behalf • Access management – Using AWS KMS key policies and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies to implement role-based access control (RBAC) or attribute-based access control (ABAC).

results.title: Privacy Preservation - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics
results.content: Privacy preservation refers to the efforts and strategies aimed at protecting personal information in digital environments, particularly within social networking and IoT contexts, where users need to share data for personalized services while maintaining control over what information is shared and with whom. Privacy preservation in Computer Science refers to the protection of sensitive personal information from unauthorized exposure, ensuring that user data is not revealed to third parties without the consent or knowledge of the data owner. Privacy protection frameworks in cloud computing integrate access control, trust, and encryption technologies, and may employ blockchain-based mechanisms for collaborative privacy management and secure data sharing. Privacy preservation is a critical component of legal frameworks such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), and ISO/IEC 29100, which mandate transparent, accountable, and fair handling of personal data, as well as the protection and security of all stakeholders’ information in digital ecosystems, including healthcare and other domains.
